entities.name: PMID:27515948
observations: Thai acute malaria cohort (n=50; 9 severe): plasma Galectin-9 was higher in severe than uncomplicated cases at day 0 (923 vs 617 pg/mL, P=0.03) and day 7 (659 vs 348 pg/mL, P=0.02); levels declined over follow-up.

entities.name: Galectin-9 (LGALS9)
observations: Plasma level was associated with acute malaria severity and inflammatory/renal markers in one small human Thai cohort; no validated association with parasitemia or mortality was identified.

entities.name: Malaria severity Galectin-9
observations: In one Thai cohort, plasma Galectin-9 was approximately 1.5-fold higher in severe versus uncomplicated malaria at day 0 and 1.9-fold higher at day 7; single-cohort evidence is preliminary.
